title: Benowitz Kirtland video of a saucer with a PSA plane behind
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Benowitz Kirtland video of a saucer with a PSA plane behind, about c. 1980 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: there's one of them that looks like a saucer kind of like this. And there's a there's a there's a PSA Pacific Southwest Airlines plane flying behind it.

plain: A writer named Greg Bishop says that around 1980 a man named Paul Benowitz filmed objects near Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Bishop says one clip shows something shaped like a saucer with a Pacific Southwest Airlines passenger plane flying behind it, which, if true, would give a sense of the object's size and place in the sky.
